svg.title: Ratatoskr: an agent network
svg.desc: Ratatoskr, drawn as a fierce gold beast in the style of Viking Age carving, with a drill-tooth tusk, a rune-stick message in its claws and a tail that interlaces around its body. It is encircled by the serpent Níðhöggr, whose body is carved with its name in runes. Around the ring, nodes on a network mark Claude Code, Codex, pi, OpenCode and other agents, and the app development, devops and infrastructure work they share.
svg.text: A network where your agents find
each other and work as a team.
